details.effect: Ward. [fanfare] Select an enemy follower on the field and give it [attack]-1/[defense]-1 for every Cute follower on your field. [act] Lesson (1): Select an enemy follower on the field and give it [attack]-1/[defense]-1. Activate only once per turn.

issues: Remove "fanfare" from keywords; Fanfare should be represented by the fanfare-timed ability, not as a keyword.

The fanfare debuff is encoded as dealDamage, but the source gives the selected enemy follower [attack]-1/[defense]-1 for every Cute follower on your field. Encode this as a stat reduction effect on the target with dynamic atk and def equal to negative Cute follower count.
The activated ability cost is incorrect: Lesson (1) should be represented as an activated ability with a 1 PP cost, not cost.pp 0 plus optionalCost/spendPp.
The activated ability effect is encoded as dealDamage -1, but it should give the selected enemy follower [attack]-1/[defense]-1. Encode it as a target buff/stat reduction with atk -1 and def -1.
The activated ability is missing the once-per-turn restriction from "Activate only once per turn." Add oncePerTurn: true to the activated ability.

details.effect: [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this. [fanfare] Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Natura card from among them and add it to your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

issues: Remove "evolve" and "fanfare" from keywords; the evolve cost line should be represented by evolveCost/evolvesTo and Fanfare by the fanfare ability, not keyword entries.
